metadata.name: hook_collectible
metadata.description: hookpool template: every buy earns the buyer generated collectibles (Metaplex Core), seeded by the trade

instructions.name: deliver
docs: Hand the Metaplex Core assets of pieces that moved in a transfer to the wallet whose
list now holds them. Anyone may send it. The assets go in remaining accounts; one
that is not in this ticket's list, or is already with its holder, is skipped.

instructions.name: execute
docs: Token-2022 calls this on every transfer of a pegged coin, after the balances moved.
uPEG's `_afterTokenTransfer`: the pieces the sender's coins no longer back leave the
sender, from the end of its list. They go to the receiver while it has a ticket and
this transfer added whole units to its associated token account, one piece per unit
added; the rest is burned. A transfer out of the pool is a buy and moves nothing.
This runs inside every transfer, also inside every sell, so it makes no CPI, reads
the tickets as raw bytes, and answers `Ok` to everything that is a real transfer.

instructions.name: init_peg
docs: Bind a pegged coin to this config, before the pool exists. The coin must be a
Token-2022 mint whose transfer hook is this program and can never be changed. The
mint signs: only whoever creates the coin can bind it, and only once. Creates the
account list Token-2022 passes to `execute`, and the pool's burn queue.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The coin. It signs, so only whoever creates the mint can bind it.

instructions.name: init_pool_config
docs: Before `create_pool`. Creates the config and the Metaplex Core collection.

instructions.name: mint
docs: Reveal what can be revealed, then mint up to `count` decided pieces. A no-op when
none are decided yet. Waiting pieces the wallet no longer holds the coins for are
dropped first, so nothing unbacked is ever minted. The asset accounts go in
remaining accounts. The wallet pays the rent, and is paid back what the assets cost
out of its deposit, as far as the deposit goes: a wallet that deposited in its buy
and then mints itself never pays twice.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: Grown in the handler to hold exactly the pieces minted, its own deposit first.

accounts.name: coins
docs: in the handler.

instructions.name: mint_for
docs: Anyone may mint a wallet's decided pieces INTO THAT WALLET, paid by the wallet's
deposit (what its ticket holds above the rent, sent in with the buy). Same checks as
`mint`: what can be revealed is revealed, waiting pieces the wallet's coins no longer
back are dropped, and the pieces are exactly what `mint` would make; nothing about
them depends on who sends this or when. It mints every decided piece, up to four, and
needs that many asset addresses. The sender pays the Metaplex rent and is paid back,
out of the deposit, exactly what it spent plus `KEEPER_FEE`; the ticket's growth stays
in the ticket, paid by the deposit. A deposit that does not cover all of it is
refused (`DepositTooSmall`) and nothing is created.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the Metaplex rent and is paid back from the deposit, with `KEEPER_FEE`.

accounts.name: user
docs: ticket by its address and `has_one`.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: Grown in the handler, out of its own deposit.

accounts.name: coins
docs: in the handler.

instructions.name: open_ticket
docs: The buyer creates their ticket for a pool, once. Without it a buy earns nothing.
Opening a ticket that is already open does nothing, so a ticket somebody else opened
for this wallet first never makes the wallet's own transaction fail.

instructions.name: open_ticket_for
docs: Open the ticket of any wallet, paid by whoever sends this. A wallet needs a ticket
to receive pieces in a transfer of a pegged coin.

instructions.name: reap
docs: Burn the Metaplex Core assets of pieces a pegged coin's transfers burned. Anyone may
send it and receives their rent. The assets go in remaining accounts; one that is
not in the burn queue is skipped.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the fee and receives the rent of the assets it burns.

accounts.name: queue
docs: hook does, so nothing is written back over them when the instruction ends.

instructions.name: reorder
docs: The wallet's own order: the piece at `from` goes to `to`, the others shift. Burns
take from the end, so the pieces to keep go first. Only a wallet whose coins back
all its pieces may reorder: a wallet above the peg cannot shuffle its list to dodge
a settle.

accounts.name: coins
docs: in the handler.

instructions.name: reveal
docs: Anyone may lock in the outcome of anyone's ticket once its block has passed. The
watcher does this for every ticket, so nobody can sit on an unrevealed result.

instructions.name: send_pieces
docs: Move pieces to another wallet together with the coins behind them: `unit` coins per
piece. A piece never travels without its coins. The pieces go in remaining accounts;
the receiving wallet's ticket is opened here if it has none, and grows at the
sender's cost. The sender's ticket shrinks to its list; the rent it frees stays in it,
as the sender's deposit.

instructions.name: set_owner
docs: Pass Pubkey::default() to lock the collection forever.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Anyone may settle any wallet. A wallet holds at most one piece per `unit` coins in
its token account. What is above that is removed, newest first: waiting pieces are
dropped, then minted pieces are burned from the end of the wallet's list. The
assets that may burn go in remaining accounts, in any order: the program burns the
last piece of the list while it finds it there and the wallet is above the peg,
and stops otherwise. Nothing else is ever burned. The rent of a burned piece's
asset goes to whoever sends this. The ticket then shrinks to its list: the rent of
the bytes the burned pieces took stays in the ticket, as the wallet's deposit, and
none of it goes to the sender.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the fee and receives the rent of the pieces it burns.

accounts.name: coins
docs: checked in the handler.

instructions.name: stage
docs: Pegged coins: send chosen pieces with exactly their coins, uPEG's `transferUpeg`.
The holder puts the pieces at the end of its list, stages `count` of them, and
transfers `unit` coins for each in the same transaction: the hook moves the staged
pieces to the receiver even though the sender's coins would still back them. One
staged piece travels per whole unit sent. The stage holds for this slot only and is
spent by the wallet's first transfer. A staged piece is never burned for being
staged: without room at the receiver it stays.
The pieces to send go in remaining accounts, in list order. If the end of the list
is not exactly them, nothing is staged and the transaction fails, so a piece that
reached the list in the meantime can never travel in their place.

accounts.name: coins
docs: in the handler.

instructions.name: update_collection
docs: Owner only, while not locked. Changes apply to pieces minted from now on.

instructions.name: withdraw_deposit
docs: The wallet takes its whole deposit back: everything its ticket holds above the rent.
A ticket longer than its list (one an older version of this program grew for more
pieces than it minted, or one whose pieces left before tickets shrank) first shrinks
to fit, so the rent of the bytes nobody uses comes back too.

errors.name: BadName
errors.msg: name is empty or longer than 24 bytes

errors.name: BadUriBase
errors.msg: renderer base uri is empty or longer than 80 bytes

errors.name: BadUnit
errors.msg: unit must be greater than zero

errors.name: BadSupply
errors.msg: max supply must be greater than zero

errors.name: BadMaxPerBuy
errors.msg: max per buy must be between 1 and 5

errors.name: WrongPool
errors.msg: config does not belong to this pool

errors.name: WrongCreator
errors.msg: config was not created by the pool creator

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: only the collection owner can do this

errors.name: Locked
errors.msg: collection is locked

errors.name: WrongTicket
errors.msg: ticket does not belong to this wallet and pool

errors.name: WrongAsset
errors.msg: asset account is not the expected address

errors.name: SlotHashes
errors.msg: slot hashes sysvar could not be read

errors.name: WrongCoins
errors.msg: that is not the wallet's token account for this coin

errors.name: NotHeld
errors.msg: the wallet does not hold this piece

errors.name: BadIndex
errors.msg: no such position in the wallet's list

errors.name: BadCount
errors.msg: send between 1 and 4 pieces at a time

errors.name: SameWallet
errors.msg: a wallet cannot send pieces to itself

errors.name: ListFull
errors.msg: the receiving wallet's list is full

errors.name: AboveThePeg
errors.msg: this wallet holds more pieces than its coins back: settle it first

errors.name: NotATransfer
errors.msg: only the token program calls this, in the middle of a transfer of this coin

errors.name: BadPegMint
errors.msg: the coin must be a Token-2022 mint whose transfer hook is this program, with no hook authority

errors.name: AlreadyPegged
errors.msg: this config is already bound to a coin

errors.name: NotPegged
errors.msg: a pegged coin trades in one pool only, the one it was bound to

errors.name: UseTransfer
errors.msg: this coin carries its pieces in a plain transfer: move the piece to the end of the list and send the coins

errors.name: WrongQueue
errors.msg: the burn queue does not belong to this pool

errors.name: NotPeggedCoin
errors.msg: staging is for pegged coins; a plain coin sends its pieces with send_pieces

errors.name: NotStaged
errors.msg: the end of the wallet's list is not the pieces named: the list changed, nothing was staged

errors.name: WrongHook
errors.msg: this pool does not run this hook

errors.name: DepositTooSmall
errors.msg: the wallet's deposit does not cover this mint: the rent of the pieces, the ticket's growth and the keeper fee

errors.name: NothingToMint
errors.msg: no decided piece to mint for this wallet

errors.name: TooFewAssets
errors.msg: a mint for another wallet mints every decided piece, up to 4: pass that many asset addresses

errors.name: NoDeposit
errors.msg: this ticket holds no deposit

fields.name: pieces
docs: Pieces of this batch not minted yet.

fields.name: minted_from
docs: Pieces of this batch already minted.

fields.name: first_roll
docs: Roll number of this batch's first piece, fixed when it was earned.

fields.name: target_slot
docs: The seed is the hash of the first block at or after this slot.

fields.name: seed
docs: Zero until revealed.

fields.name: art
docs: The collection's art bytes when these pieces were earned. A piece is minted with
them, whatever the owner changes between the buy and the mint.

types.name: BurnQueue
docs: The pieces a pegged coin's transfers burned, waiting for their Metaplex Core asset to
be burned too (`reap`). The asset addresses follow this header as raw 32-byte entries;
the transfer hook appends without ever reading the list.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for this config. Must be the pool creator.

fields.name: owner
docs: May update name, renderer and art. Pubkey::default() = locked forever.

fields.name: collection
docs: The Metaplex Core collection, a PDA of this program.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: The coin and its token program, recorded by the pool when it is created (a plain
coin) or by `init_peg` (a pegged coin).

fields.name: pegged
docs: The coin is a Token-2022 mint whose transfer hook is this program: its pieces move
or burn inside every transfer.

fields.name: unit
docs: Coins (raw units) behind one piece: a buy earns one per `unit` received, and a
wallet keeps one per `unit` held. Fixed.

fields.name: max_supply
docs: The most pieces that may exist at once. Fixed.

fields.name: minted
docs: Pieces ever minted. Only numbers them.

fields.name: live
docs: Pieces that exist now.

fields.name: reserved_pending
docs: Pieces earned and waiting in tickets.

fields.name: max_per_buy
docs: Fixed.

fields.name: art_version
docs: Bumped on every art or renderer change.

fields.name: art
docs: Opaque art parameters, copied into every piece's URI at mint time.

types.name: DepositUsed
docs: A mint took lamports out of the wallet's deposit: `mint` by the wallet itself, or
`mint_for` by anyone. `paid` went to `by`.

fields.name: pieces
docs: Pieces this call minted.

fields.name: paid
docs: Lamports paid to `by`: what it spent on the assets, plus `KEEPER_FEE` for `mint_for`.

fields.name: left
docs: The deposit left after this call.

types.name: DepositWithdrawn
docs: The wallet took its whole deposit back.

types.name: PieceDelivered
docs: The Metaplex asset of a piece that moved in a transfer was handed to its holder.

types.name: PiecesCancelled
docs: Waiting pieces dropped because the wallet no longer holds the coins for them.

types.name: PiecesTransferred
docs: What one transfer of a pegged coin did to the sender's pieces.

fields.name: dropped
docs: Waiting pieces dropped.

fields.name: moved
docs: Pieces that moved to the receiver's list.

fields.name: burned
docs: Pieces burned (queued for `reap`).

fields.name: reserve_base
docs: Reserves at the moment of the callback (before the swap in `before_swap`,
after it in `after_swap`).

fields.name: minted
docs: Pieces this wallet has ever minted on this pool: the index of its next asset address.

fields.name: rolls
docs: Pieces this wallet has ever earned on this pool. Each piece's roll number comes
from here at buy time and never moves.

fields.name: staged
docs: Pegged coins: how many pieces, from the end of the list, travel with the wallet's
next transfer even though its coins would still back them. Only honoured in the
slot it was set in, so a stale stage can never move a piece by surprise.

fields.name: owned
docs: The pieces this wallet holds, in the wallet's own order. A burn takes the last one.
